debit.sms: BLOCKCARD <last 4 digits of Debit Card no.> (sample: BLOCKCARD 1234) to 56161600 or +919951860002 from your registered mobile number
debit.notes: Lost-card lines: 1800 4030 / 1800 8911 (Toll free) for credit or debit cards; 080-6802-6802 / 040-4886-8888 covers credit, debit and pre-paid cards. 24-hour Emergency Helpline +91 40 67174100 is not toll free; the NRI section lists it as the non-toll-free number to India (+91-40-6717-4100) plus country-wise NRI toll-free numbers (India 1800 108 5577, UAE 8000 3570 3218, UK 0808 178 5040, USA 001855 205 5577). The lost-card FAQ on the credit-card page (which hosts the debit block form) also lists a 24-hour helpline, +91-22-67987700. Website key opens Axis's official debit-card block form: enter your registered mobile number to block the card and order a replacement. No debit netbanking/app menu path, no block-request email and no 1930 mention on the pages sourced here.

credit.sms: BLOCK<last 4 digits of credit card no.> (sample: BLOCK 9075) to 56161600 or +919951860002 from your registered mobile number
credit.notes: 24x7. Axis Mobile App: open the credit cards section via 'quick links' and use 'Block and replace Card'; Internet Banking: open the 'Credit Cards' section to block the card. The lost-card FAQ also says to send "BLOCKCARD" to 5676782 or +919717000002 (its intro describes the message as "BLOCKXXXX", XXXX = last 4 digits of the card number). Website key is the official credit-card block form: enter your registered mobile number to block and order a replacement. Other live credit-card customer-care numbers: 1860-419-5555 / 1860-500-5555 (Charges Applicable) and 1800-103-5577 (Toll Free Number); forex card customer service 1800-108-5577 (toll-free) or +91 040 67174100; from abroad the non-toll-free line to India is +91-40-6717-4100. No block-request email or 1930 mention on the pages sourced here.

upi.notes: SMS freeze (send from your registered mobile number): BLOCKUPI <Customer ID> (example BLOCKUPI 123456) — 'Helps you block your UPI access'; BLOCKALL <Customer ID> (example BLOCKALL 123456) — 'Helps you block your Internet Banking, Mobile Banking and UPI access'; send keywords to SMS Banking numbers 56161600 or +91 9951860002. NPCI UPI Help (upihelp.npci.org.in, linked from Axis's UPI page) offers a Safety Switch to 'pause outgoing UPI debit transactions from the selected account' — 'Outgoing UPI debit transactions from the selected account are blocked. Incoming UPI credits continue.'; it cannot be resumed there: 'contact Axis Bank Phone Banking or visit your nearest Axis Bank branch to request the resumption of outgoing UPI payments'. Phone Banking (toll free): 1800 4030 / 1800 8911. For a fraudulent UPI transaction, report immediately to Axis Bank 'through the available customer service channels' and also lodge a complaint 'on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal or through the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930'. No netbanking UPI-manage path, in-app UPI lock menu path or app-store link is published on Axis pages; *99# is not mentioned.
